scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix apps/server && npm install --prefix apps/web && node scripts/setup.js
scripts.dev: concurrently --names "docker,server,web" --prefix-colors "yellow,cyan,magenta" "docker compose up" "npm run dev --prefix apps/server" "npm run dev --prefix apps/web"
scripts.build: concurrently "npm run build --prefix apps/server" "npm run build --prefix apps/web"
